decisions.reason: The ACE3 distributed airfield lighting control unit sits at the core of the firm's established ALCMS expertise, where its in-house R&D and long operational experience let it interpret early results and keep improving the product, so dropping it would discard closely related knowledge just after a flagship launch.

The surveillance air situation display builds on the firm's tower and integration know-how and supports its move toward integrated, real-time airport operations, so its absorptive capacity justifies keeping it despite its lower visibility than the lighting core.
